title: Noteblock Glow
description: Note blocks glow bright when powered by redstone. Pure vanilla resource pack.
body:
## ✨ What it does

When a **Note Block** is powered by redstone, its texture switches to a **brighter, highlighted version** — making it easy to spot active blocks in complex redstone music setups.

- Pure client-side **resource pack** — no mods required
- Does not affect note pitch, instrument, or redstone behavior
- Compatible with OptiFine, Sodium, Iris, and other render mods

## 📝 How to use

1. Drop the resource pack into `.minecraft/resourcepacks/`
2. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs**
3. Power a note block with redstone — it will glow!
4. For a specific version, **please check the version description.**

## ⚠️ Limitations

- This is a **texture swap** effect, not actual light emission, need datapack [download](https://modrinth.com/datapack/noteblock-glow-datapack#download) 
- The "glow" does **not** illuminate surrounding blocks or prevent mobs from spawning
- In very dark environments, the texture will still dim slightly due to Minecraft's lighting engine

## 🔧 Technical Details

- Uses the `powered` blockstate of `note_block` to switch models
- Overrides texture for `powered=true` state
